evidence.name: Screen field: What Fills The Background
evidence.userNeed: Know what "What Fills The Background" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: What Fills The Background
sections.description: Chooses what sits behind your content: a solid color, a photo, or a video clip, and reveals the matching control below. Defaults to a solid color. Use solid for clean question screens, a photo for emotive intro screens, and video only for short high-impact openers, since heavy video slows loading and can lose paid-ad visitors.
